description:
COSTS MONEY: Purchase a phone number

Buys one of the numbers returned by the search and attaches it to the account. Buying numbers needs an active Voice subscription (Voice, Bundle or a voice capable plan) and is not possible during the free trial; otherwise the request is rejected with 403 and one of the codes `voice_subscription_required`, `voice_subscription_inactive` or `trial_not_allowed`, before anything is charged. This charges money: the setup price plus the first month, plus VAT, is deducted from the account wallet, a balance transaction is written and an invoice is issued. An account managed by a provider (a partner of EchoCall) pays the provider's price as the search shows it and gets the invoice from that provider; when the provider cannot take the order right now the request is rejected with 400 `provider_unavailable`, nothing is bought and the provider is informed. Pass the listing from the search result back unchanged.

body.description: The listing to buy, exactly as returned by the search. `availableDidId` and `skuId` identify the listing at the marketplace, `features` lists the capabilities of the number, and `requirementId` names the regulatory requirement set to satisfy, if there is one. The four price fields are deprecated: they are optional, they are ignored, and the server prices the purchase itself. They remain in the schema only so integrations that echo a whole search result back keep working.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
